variables.name: ECHO_HOSTNAME
variables.description: hostname of the container that echoes back the HTTP method it received

variables.name: PAGING_HOSTNAME
variables.description: hostname of the paginating API used by the pagination tests

variables.name: SSE_HOSTNAME
variables.description: go-httpbin instance, used for the Server-Sent Events tests

variables.name: PROXY_HOST
variables.description: hostname of the squid forward proxy

variables.name: PROXY_AUTH_PORT
variables.description: squid port that demands Basic credentials

variables.name: PROXY_ONLY_HOST
variables.description: origin on the internal network, reachable only through the proxy

variables.name: HTTPS_HOST
variables.description: hostname of the TLS test server

variables.name: HTTPS_PORT
variables.description: TLS port of the tomcat service - its server.xml puts https on 8080

variables.name: PROXY_USER
variables.description: username for the authenticating squid port

variables.name: PROXY_PASS
variables.description: password for the authenticating squid port
